falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes below $42,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive break below the key support level would invalidate the transition_2020_dec_breakout pattern, which requires price to hold above the prior consolidation range. This would signal the breakout has failed and the HOLD verdict is wrong.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on major perp exchanges (Binance, OKX, Bybit) turns negative for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 2020 December breakout analog was characterized by sustained positive funding as leveraged longs piled in. Persistent negative funding would indicate bearish sentiment and structural short positioning, contradicting the bullish continuation thesis.

falsification_conditions.condition: Weekly RSI (14) on BTC/USD drops below 50
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The transition_2020_dec_breakout pattern requires momentum to remain in bullish territory. A weekly RSI below 50 would show momentum has flipped bearish, invalidating the breakout continuation and suggesting the blowoff score of 48 is mispriced.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
